name: Valeria Quispe
bio:
Valeria's journey into motorsport began in her youth, captivated by the roar of engines at a local karting track in Lima. Despite initial resistance from her family, who envisioned a more traditional career path, she pursued her passion, earning a degree in mechanical engineering from the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru. Her early career saw her working in automotive manufacturing before she transitioned to racing, initially volunteering with smaller teams to gain experience.

Valeria is known for her meticulous approach to data analysis and her ability to translate complex technical information into actionable insights for the driver. She believes in building strong relationships with her team members, fostering open communication and mutual respect. While demanding, her focus remains on achieving optimal performance and pushing the boundaries of what's possible on the track. Her distinctive trait is her ability to quickly diagnose issues even under immense pressure, a skill honed by years of experience in challenging racing environments.

Valeria has joined Reiza Studios Factory team to make a mark on the world stage. Her deep expertise in vehicle dynamics, combined with a pragmatic, data-driven approach, makes her a valuable asset. She is determined to contribute to the team's success and create a winning environment for everyone involved.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Valeria is of average height with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when concentrating.
Insists on a specific brand of Peruvian coffee before every race.
